steps.title: Prepare CSV input files
steps.instruction: Create three separate CSV files (urea, buffer, sample) each with a header line and an "x" in the top‑left well; list volumes for each well; use "x" for wells that receive no volume; order the files for plates 1, 2, then 3.

steps.title: Load plates and tip racks
steps.instruction: Place up to three 384‑well plates in slots 1, 2, and 3 (in that order). Load tip racks on the specified mounts and select the P20 or P300 single‑channel pipette on the left or right mount according to the volumes in the CSVs. Ensure the urea and buffer source tubes contain the initial volume (in mL) specified for the run.

steps.title: Add urea to plates
steps.instruction: Using a single tip for the urea reagent, dispense the volumes indicated in the urea CSV into the corresponding wells of plates 1, 2, and 3.

steps.title: Add buffer to plates
steps.instruction: Using a single tip for the buffer reagent, dispense the volumes indicated in the buffer CSV into the corresponding wells of plates 1, 2, and 3, positioning the tip 5 mm above the bottom of each well.

steps.title: Add sample and mix
steps.instruction: For each well of plates 1, 2, and 3, use a fresh tip (change tip for each well) to dispense the sample volume from the sample CSV, then mix the well by aspirating and dispensing 20 µL for 3 repetitions.

steps.title: Refill tips if needed
steps.instruction: If the protocol runs out of tips, it will pause; refill the tip racks and resume the run.
